name: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub / Smart Village data center
notes: Telecom Egypt announced the Smart Village/West Cairo facility in October 2020; DCD identified the site as 6th of October City, Giza. W.Media reported RDH phase 1 was delivered in 2021 with 2.5 MW IT load and reached full utilization in 2022.

name: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub 2 (RDH2)
notes: ECG project page describes RDH2 as completed with 4.9 MW total IT load and 510 racks; Datacenters.com places RDH2 in 6th of October City, Giza. W.Media says RDH2 was slated for 2025 completion but Telecom Egypt had not publicly confirmed full operation as of July 2026, so status is conservatively construction.

name: Telecom Egypt October 1 Data Center
notes: DT-Holding lists October1 Data Center in October 6, Egypt among eight Telecom Egypt protected data centers; Datacenters.com places October 1 in Smart Village, 6th of October City, Giza Governorate.

name: Telecom Egypt October 2 Data Center
notes: DT-Holding lists October2 Data Center in October 6, Egypt among eight Telecom Egypt protected data centers; October 6 is in Giza Governorate.

name: Telecom Egypt Manti data center
notes: Inflect lists Telecom Egypt Manti as a data center at 26 Ramsis, Shubra Al Khayma, Al Qalyubia Governorate, with colocation/connectivity services and CAIX presence.

name: Telecom Egypt West Qena Data Center
notes: DT-Holding lists West Qena Data Center, Qena, Egypt among eight Telecom Egypt protected data centers using HI-FOG water mist systems.

name: Renergy Group El Tor hyperscale green data center
notes: Egypt Oil & Gas reported Renergy expressed interest in a $1 billion hyperscale green data center in the El Tor area, South Sinai, integrated with a broader renewables/green hydrogen project; DCD noted details were sparse.
